report.name: Прогресс по проекту
report.description: Для анализа изменения количества требований и тестовых ситуаций на основе истории коммитов.

param.name: dateFrom
param.description: Statistics will be filtered from this date. Example "Wed Nov 24 18:39:39 MSK 2021". Not presented by default.

param.name: dateTo
param.description: Statistics will be filtered up to this date. Example "Wed Nov 24 18:39:39 MSK 2021". Not presented by default.

param.name: step
param.description: Step on which data will be collected. Value may include "day", "week", "year", "month" notation. Example "1 week 2 day". Shoren versions like "d","w","y","m" are also supported.

param.name: coverageSettings
param.description: Coverage settings. May include coverageFilePath or pair coverageStorageType and coverageStorageSettings

attribute.name: coverageFilePath
attribute.description: Path to file with coverage info

attribute.name: coverageStorageSettings
attribute.description: Coverage info source-related settings. Will depend on source type. Separator is |
